host_shape_gate.kv: Require 24 KV-producing source layers, two KV groups per source layer, layer/head dimensions matching the pinned host source map; require finite normalized K/V arrays in pre-RoPE canonical coordinates.
host_shape_gate.mapping: Use `gemma4_source_kv_mapping` exactly as frozen in the MI1 source: direct mapping for producer layers, then shared source `24 - 2` for SWA query layers and `24 - 1` for full-attention query layers; record all 42 query→KV source pairs and validate every selected site resolves.
host_shape_gate.query: Require all query layers 0–41, eight Q heads per layer, and recorded per-layer Q head dimension from model capture.
host_shape_gate.selector: Run calibration-only query capture over all 42 query layers/eight heads with target+reference bank diagnostics; after scoring, freeze top-one KV group per layer and top-four layers, expanded to associated query heads; store full per-layer scores, selected sites and query→KV map before any generation. No heldout prompt/query enters selector.

no_change_to: selected tasks/split, process card, prompt wording, conditions, seed schedule, score rubric, thresholds, layer budget, gain candidates, heldout embargo or stop criteria

operator_settings.layer_gain: Current Gemma patch does not provide independent per-layer rho; use one frozen global bank_logit_bias chosen by calibration rule.

paper_appendix_c_selector_reference_bank.diagnostic_use: For selector score only: normalized pre-RoPE final prompt-token Q against target-card K vs this reference-card K; Eq. 3 max similarity difference; record attention-mass diagnostic. The deployed latent condition contains only target bank, not the reference bank.
paper_appendix_c_selector_reference_bank.encoding: Same raw plus internal-principles plus private-reasoning-note context procedure and descriptor-only token-span retention as target and irrelevant banks. It is not supplied to the model in ordinary generation prompts.
paper_appendix_c_selector_reference_bank.exact_text: General problem-solving note: Identify exactly what the problem asks for. Choose a standard method that fits the stated assumptions. Show the steps needed to justify the result, and check that the final answer addresses the requested quantity.
paper_appendix_c_selector_reference_bank.purpose: The target/reference alignment term in Eq. 3 requires a comparison bank; this neutral generic procedure is used only during selector calibration and is not attached during generation or scored as a test condition.

token_position_recording.frozen_rule: For each template, tokenize exactly once using the pinned Gemma vocabulary with BOS enabled and control-token parsing disabled for raw note text. Retain only the unique exact token-id subsequence for the complete card text, excluding BOS. For contextualized encodings, require the card token sequence to occur exactly once; record both full token_ids and retained integer positions in bank manifest. Preserve original slot ordering and template provenance.
token_position_recording.pre_generation_gate: Before any calibration generation, build target/reference/irrelevant banks; record full token-ID sequences and retained integer positions; verify each bank has 3 × card token count slots, no wrapper/BOS slots, slot alignment, SHA-256, finite tensors and expected host dimensions. A mismatch stops calibration.
